## Purpose and Entry Points
Cake Wallet is a non-custodial, privacy-oriented, multi-currency Flutter wallet targeting Android, iOS, macOS, Linux, and Windows. The Dart application starts at `lib/main.dart`, composes dependencies in `lib/di.dart`, and routes UI through `lib/router.dart` and `lib/routes.dart`. Native launchers host Flutter on each platform, including `android/app/src/main/java/com/cakewallet/cake_wallet/MainActivity.java`, `ios/Runner/AppDelegate.swift`, and `linux/main.cc`.

## Application Composition and State
The app is organized as Flutter presentation code over MobX-style stores and view models. Shared app/session state, settings, wallet selection, nodes, trades, and authentication live under `lib/store/app_store.dart`, `lib/store/settings_store.dart`, and `lib/store/wallet_list_store.dart`. Screen-facing orchestration is concentrated in `lib/view_model/`, such as `lib/view_model/send/send_view_model.dart` and `lib/view_model/wallet_creation_vm.dart`. Reactive lifecycle hooks connect wallet, node, fiat, and authentication changes in `lib/reactions/bootstrap.dart` and `lib/reactions/on_current_wallet_change.dart`.

## Wallet Domain Boundary
`cw_core` defines chain-agnostic wallet contracts and persistent/domain types: wallet lifecycle, credentials, balances, addresses, transactions, nodes, proxying, and hardware-wallet abstractions. Key boundary paths are `cw_core/lib/wallet_base.dart`, `cw_core/lib/wallet_service.dart`, and `cw_core/lib/wallet_info.dart`. The main app depends on these abstractions rather than directly coupling most UI flows to chain implementations; wallet creation, restoration, loading, and backup are coordinated through `lib/core/wallet_creation_service.dart`, `lib/core/wallet_loading_service.dart`, and `lib/core/backup_service_v3.dart`.

## Chain Implementations and Network Access
Per-chain Dart packages implement the core interfaces and expose chain-specific signing, syncing, address, token, and transaction behavior. Major implementations include Monero (`cw_monero/lib/monero_wallet_service.dart`, `cw_monero/lib/api/wallet_manager.dart`), UTXO Bitcoin/Litecoin (`cw_bitcoin/lib/bitcoin_wallet_service.dart`, `cw_bitcoin/lib/electrum_wallet.dart`), EVM (`cw_evm/lib/evm_chain_wallet_service.dart`, `cw_evm/lib/clients/evm_chain_client.dart`), and Solana/Tron (`cw_solana/lib/solana_client.dart`, `cw_tron/lib/tron_http_provider.dart`). Default RPC, Electrum, and node endpoints are bundled as assets, e.g. `assets/bitcoin_electrum_server_list.yml`, `assets/ethereum_server_list.yml`, and `assets/solana_node_list.yml`; users can manage endpoint selection via `lib/core/node_switching_service.dart`.

## User Flows and UI Surfaces
The established UI is screen-oriented under `lib/src/screens/`, with root/authentication, dashboard, send/receive, wallet onboarding, exchange, and settings flows. Representative controllers are `lib/src/screens/root/root.dart`, `lib/src/screens/send/send_page.dart`, and `lib/src/screens/new_wallet/new_wallet_page.dart`. A parallel newer interface resides in `lib/new-ui/`, including `lib/new-ui/new_dashboard.dart`, `lib/new-ui/pages/send_page.dart`, and `lib/new-ui/pages/swap_page.dart`. Both surfaces consume the same stores, view models, wallet services, and route infrastructure.

## Payments, Swaps, and External Services
Transaction creation flows from UI/view models into the selected wallet implementation and its network client; pending transaction models provide the confirmation/broadcast boundary. Address input is normalized or resolved across DNS/domain and social-address schemes by `lib/core/address_resolver/address_resolver_service.dart`, `lib/core/universal_address_detector.dart`, and `lib/core/lightning_invoice_service.dart`. Third-party integrations are adapter-driven: exchange providers in `lib/exchange/provider/exchange_provider.dart`, fiat on-ramp providers in `lib/buy/buy_provider.dart`, Cake Pay APIs in `lib/cake_pay/src/services/cake_pay_api.dart`, and WalletConnect signing/session support in `lib/src/screens/wallet_connect/services/walletkit_service.dart`.

## Privacy, Native Dependencies, and Delivery
Network privacy is a first-class cross-cutting boundary: core supports SOCKS/proxy and Tor implementations in `cw_core/lib/utils/proxy_wrapper.dart` and `cw_core/lib/utils/tor/torch.dart`; app startup/settings expose these controls through `lib/view_model/start_tor_view_model.dart`. Secure key/PIN operations bridge to platform facilities via `cw_core/lib/set_app_secure_native.dart`, `ios/CakeWallet/decrypt.swift`, and `macos/CakeWallet/decrypt.swift`. Several chains require native libraries/plugins—Monero, MWEB, Zcash, Decred, and Wownero—built through platform scripts such as `scripts/android/build_monero_all.sh`, `scripts/ios/build_zcash.sh`, and `scripts/linux/build_all.sh`. Docker-based Android builds and CI workflows support reproducible packaging (`scripts/android/docker/build.sh`, `.github/workflows/reusable-build.yml`).
